name: Pattern Recognition Engine
description: Introduces Pandora Genome as a static single source of truth and unifies future improvement work around the EvolutionProposal model and one controlled lifecycle.
features: Unified EvolutionProposal model for all future proposal types
Genome validation and hard evolution rules
Read-only migration preview for existing proposal systems
safety: No runtime mutation of the Genome
No automatic Identity or Personality changes
Python validates LLM recommendations before any action
